nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Glass Glow Hydrogel Mask

avis.titre: Neither hate it nor I love it
avis.texte: As someone with dry and sensitive skin I'm in search of a good, non-irritating, and fragrace-free face mask, but this just isn't it. I don't have any real complaints, other than it making my face tingle a little at first, but I also didn't see much change -mind you, I only used it a couple times- or anything that really made me want to buy this again.

I used this mask as a overnight treatment as derected on the box. I woke up with red spots on my face and a itchy-burning session. I would not use this mask again but if I had to i'd onky use it for max 20 minutes. I do have sensitive skin but havent had any problems with face masks expect for this one.
I will never not use this mask as long as its available! I wear it until its transparent then remove and my skin is like glass and is glowing! LOVE!!!!!

I have used the power essence for years now and love that. I have used a similar overnight sheet/collegan based mask before and loved that too. Why wouldn't I try this and love it? WRONG it left my face red and hot, no pain or itching but a bright red tint and heat like I have sun burn. I am hoping Ulta will take back the two considering I used one and it was awful.
Im not sure what happened but these burned my face. I felt a burning sensation and when I took them off, I was red. It felt like a very bad sunburn .
My skin was so hydrated and glowy after using one of these. I wore it for 3 hours or so and most of the white had disappeared by then.

avis.titre: Buy it if your needs hydration
avis.texte: I have super sensitive dry skin, this didn't irritate my skin at all. I left it on for 3hrs, my skin was glowing, and felt very hydrated. Don't just buy one buy two.
I love that its more than enough product in the mask. It provides hydration for sure. Lovr that the mask changes as it works.

This mask was hydrating to begin with but 6-7 hours after using this, i started getting small red papules around cheeks . its seemed like my skin didnt react well to snail mucin and got irritated. For reference, i have combination sensitive skin. I applied this mask at night after face wash and took it off 4 hours later ( because i couldnt get any sleep with it). I say take the risk if you want to. It may work for someone else.

I've been struggling with dry patches and breakouts from my skin being so dry. I just used one of these for about two hours because i tried the other COSRX snail mucin mask and wanted to give this one a shot and WOW. It leaves skin plumped and hydrated without leaving any wetness or sticky residue. It truly soaks right into the skin! I'm too rough of a sleeper or I would try overnight, but two hours made my skin feel AMAZING!
Yall when i tell you this mask is IT. I got all the girlies at work to try them out and they LOVEEE. Just get it, its amazing. I keep it overnight and i wake up with soft, plumped, glowy skin.
I've tried applying the mask and it doesn't adhere to the skin well. I cleaned my face, applied the moisturizer and then applies the mask. It's very slippery and doesn't stay in place too good

I was able to use for 3 hours and then removed - mask had become translucent by then. My skin looks amazing - immediately ordered more. Not a mask to wear while trying to do other things though it forms to the face very well. Applied another HA and peptide serum first. Just amazing results. Will apply just before bed next time to see overnight results.

I was able to use for 3 hours and then removed - mask had become translucent by then. My skin looks amazing - immediately ordered more. Not a mask to wear while trying to do other things though it forms to the face very well. Applied another HA and peptide serum first. Just amazing results. Will apply just before bed next time to see overnight results.
My skin felt reinvented! Smooth, firmer and well hydrated. I highly recommend.
Love how glowy my skin looks after I use this mask! Definitely will be purchasing again.

Loved this mask so much! I've never seen my skin look so good! My skin was bright and that glass look people love. I put it on overnight after I used a dermaplaner. Purchased three more packs immediately… that good! I usually get facials every month, this is better imo.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked better
avis.texte: Love how well it stays on throughout the night. Cooling to the face and my skin looks amazing afterwards. My acne has improved and skin texture

I bought this at the store just to try. It turned out my skin felt hydrated. It looked plumpy and happy. I use it as a supplement for when I have an event going on. Definitely recommend as an add on hydrating step.

avis.titre: It's not something I would buy again
avis.texte: I used the masks for 3 weeks but nothing noticeable on the face.. may be for couple of hours thats about it.

This is my first time using this product and I absolutely love it. I put the mask on right before bed, and had no issue with putting it on. The mask also stayed on all night while sleeping. The look of my skin was great as well. I love Cosrx products.
My face loves the Glass Glow Hydrogel sheets. My skin looks fantastic for a few days after using. The results are refreshed, even texture, hydrated and glowing skin.

I am not sure about the long term helpfulness of this as I just did my first one. I left it on for two hours and my skin was so sat afterwords, my face looked far less dry the next morning and felt like a great addition to my self care routine that I am trying to tailor to my ageing skin.

Best face mask ever! My face feels hydrated for more than a week from one nights sleep with this mask! My skin looks so glowy, fresh, and hydrated. I've been giving these as gifts since my first use. A must buy!

Mask fit so well! Took a second to situate but once it was on, it felt secure. Didn't make it the full 2-3 hours of wear, but even with only a hour I could feel a huge difference. These are a new staple in my vanity now!

I will be flying internationally & I wanted to try a facemask that isnt messy & should be worn for hours on end. This is going to be perfect! Its wet, but not super slimy. I went to bed with it on no problems & woke up to it being clear & my skin looking amazing. will be repurchasing & using again!

My favourite face mask ever. This mask goes on white and as you let it sit it turns clear and clings to your skin making it durable for overnight wear. When i wake up in the morning it makes it so much faster to do my skincare in the morning because face mask protects and locks in your skincare from the night before. It makes my skin so nice and glowy not to mention that I notice it heals my acne as well as calms my skin. Perfect before important events or everyday use. Will recommend to my clients.

avis.titre: Jaw/mouth portion fits. Top doesn't fit/stay.
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this! The bottom portion fit great. The top portion? Didnt fit well- wouldnt stay tight around my nose (though there was plenty of mask) and fit loose around my eyes. It just hovered over oarts of my face. Waste of money. Maybe if you put it on for a nap? And slept on your back? Idk. Its just inconvenient and slippery.

Glass skin with the COSRX sheet mask. I was gifted these COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Power sheet masks from COSRX in exchange for my honest review. These masks are packed full of serum that has ingredients in it, such as Snail mucin, which hydrates skin. They also have collagen, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, ceramides, and Panthenol. I have oily combination skin and found that these masks work really well in hydrating my skin without creating excess oil. They also make my skin look and feel really smooth and create a lovely glow. It is recommended to wear these masks for at least 2 to 3 hours after cleansing your skin. It's even better if you wear it overnight. I've not worn it overnight as I can't take the resticting feeling on my face. These masks are thicker than sheet masks, and for me, my face did feel a little sweaty when I took the mask off. I found it pretty easy to apply these masks and found the size to be fine. I'd use these masks once or twice a week to give my skin a boost of hydration and a glowing look. I'm not 100% sure if it did give my skin the glass look, but I did like the after-effects and glow.

I had high hopes with the Korean skincare products but turns out that its their genes not really these products. I tried it 3 times… did not do any good i mean it did not do any harm either but tgays about it.

I've been using the Snail Mucin for a while, so I got excited to try these face masks. And let me just say, I can't get enough of them. They helped my face stay more hydrated I got that amazing glass skin finish after taking it off the following morning. Not only will I be repurchasing, but making sure I'm always stocked up on these masks.
after using this my skin was like glass and felt so soft 10/10 would recommend!!

I would say this mask performs as promised. It melts into skin overnight. By morning, you have a moisturized, glowing face. I suffer from rosacea and this mask helped calm my redness. The only downside is that the outcome isn't necessarily long lasting, probably a couple of days. That said, it is practically a must have before a special event, like a wedding.

I have purchased 2 boxes since its released and I love hownit gives the same results as thw viral mask from peach and lilly but at a more affordable price. I use it once or twice a week to help with the winter dry air. Im thinking once the summer comes I'll use it every other week.
I use this at night and my skin feels soft and moisturized in the morning.
I am 81 years old and this product makes my skin feel wonderful. It is hydrated and smooth after use. I will continue to buy this madk
I'm so obsessed with the results from this product! I've been using this brand's products for years now and they never disappoint me.

I have always loved hydrogel masks especially this one. It's a must for everyone but especially me. I left a long time in the hospital and I ran to my skincare chest. This mask immediately restored my skin from what I felt was catastrophic. This mask is everything.

Ive been searching for a mask like this since the slugging trend emerged. This mask was easy to apply and didnt fall off your face once it was applied. When i woke up, the mask was definitely clear and all of my skincare had penetrated into my skin!! I virtually had no pores since my skin was so plump. My skin has never been this radiant! Prior to my mask, I did the baby facial from drunk elephant and applied all of my toners and serums. I didnt experience any burning. Possibly due to my skin prep.

Wow! I tried the viral TikTok mask a few months ago to achieve the glass skin look but it only made my skin break out. When I saw that Cosrx came out with one I was beyond excited! My face in the morning looks amazing! It is so soft and glows. I absolutely love everything that Cosrx puts out. Definitely worth the try if you are on the fence about this product.

This was my first experience with a face mask that stays on for longer than 20 or so minutes. It's meant to stay on for 2-3 hours (I went to bed with it on, then took it off when I woke up to use the bathroom later). It's grippy enough where I was able to walk around getting ready for bed while wearing it, and not worry about it sliding off like my regular sheet masks. It does have an odd alien skin-like (I imagine) texture, but it was more fascinating to me than anything. A tad rubbery, vs slimy like sheet masks? I've struggled lately with my pores being larger than usual, despite my skin being dryer than usual, and my pores are a bit smaller today, which I wasn't expecting. I didn't pay a ton of attention to other results, aside from my skin having that nice post mask feel, but I definitely noticed the reduced pores without being dried out.

Totally OBSESSED with these CosRX Advanced Snail Mucin Glass Glow Hydrogel Mask. My face is left with the most beautiful glow and glass like skin. I put them on over my night regime and when I wake in the morning, its like looking at a new ME! Definitely a must have. 10/10 for me. Just look at how beautiful my skin looks!
Amazing overnight mask. It's great for skin prep before makeup. Will purchase again.
Love it. Looking forward to buy next time. It feels so good and see my face hydrated.

I have rosacea and my skin is very dry. These products have been marvelous and the mask is excellent. I left it on all night and spent the next day touching my face because I couldn't believe how soft my skin was and it has remain soft. Thank you!
This gel mask was great! I woke up with well hydrated skin after leaving the mask on overnight
the mask turn clear after about 2 hours. i use it to soothe after facial procedures. my face stay hydrated and look supple afterwards
Hi , snail essence is so good for your skin. I'm really happy for my new skin
